reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was 200 mg and 2 capsules per sachet, and it is real elemental magnesium here, which is fine, but $29.99 for 30 days is a dollar a day and my Nature Made is about 39 cents. A new brand with zero reviews does not get me to pay almost triple.
